manual_input.title: Add Sony BRAVIA Android TV
manual_input.intro: Enter the TV IP address and pre-shared key. The app communicates only with this address over HTTP/HTTPS. Automatic network discovery is not used, so this also works across VLANs when routing is allowed.

mac_address.label: MAC address (optional):
mac_address.hint: Filled automatically from the TV when possible. Only used for Wake-on-LAN.

titles.header: Setting up your Sony BRAVIA Android TV

instructions.intro: Follow the instructions in the video below. Enable Remote start so Homey can turn the TV on over the network, and set authentication to a pre-shared key.
instructions.video_caption: Press the video to open in YouTube

step_by_step.intro: All settings that need adjustment are under the Network properties of your TV. From these network settings you need to set:
step_by_step.steps:
• Remote start: Enabled
  • Home network setup
    • Authentication: Normal and Pre-shared Key
    • Pre-shared Key: Anything, but remember it
step_by_step.outro: After this, enter the TV IP address and the same pre-shared key in Homey. Existing devices from app version 2.x must be removed and added again once.
